summary: Shows a keyboard key or a key combination, as nested kbd elements in the mono face.
whenToUse: Teaching a shortcut in a tooltip, a menu item, an empty state or help text.
Inside an Input suffix to hint at the search shortcut.
whenNotToUse: Code or token names: use code.
Buttons: a Kbd is not clickable.

dos.title: Write the platform's key names
dos.text: Cmd on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere. Abbreviations get a title with the full name.

donts.title: Long sequences
donts.text: More than three keys is a recipe, not a shortcut. Explain it in text.

accessibility: Outer kbd wraps one kbd per key, the HTML pattern for keys pressed together; the plus signs are aria-hidden.
Abbreviated keys (Cmd, Esc, arrows) carry a title with the full name.
Text color is text.muted on surface (4.5:1).
contentGuidelines: Capitalize key names: Esc, Enter, Shift. Letters in capitals: K, not k.
Say the action before the keys: "Search with Cmd K".
